title: The Rev. Robert Henry Codrington

---

head of the Melanesian mission 1871-7

He succeeded the Rt. Rev. John Coleridge Patteson as head of the mission to Melanesia; he was author of a Mota Dictionary and ethnographical works on Melanesia.
